title: God Calls Samuel
reflectionQuestion: What do you think Samuel felt when he heard the gentle voice calling his name?
kidSafetyNotes: SUPERSEDES legacy kid_114_samuel (5min/3min off-bucket, no audio). The hard message God gives Samuel (judgment on Eli's house) OMITTED entirely -- just 'God spoke to Samuel.' Pure bedtime: nighttime setting, the lamp of God glowing. Not-alone spine -- God calls the child by name. 'Speak, Lord, for your servant is listening' uses 'Lord' in a quoted line (per divine-name doctrine). One image: the lamp of God glowing soft and golden as the boy sits up to listen. Adam: A+ ('pure bedtime magic').
